Commentary.Commentary: That's it then from this game and it is Australia Women who have the early lead in the five-match series. India Women will be desperate to level the series as a 2-0 deficit will be very difficult for them to overcome. The next game will be played at the very same venue on Sunday, the 11th of December and will begin at 7 pm IST (1.30 pm GMT). But, you can join us early for the build-up as always. Cheers!

Alyssa Healy, the captain of Australia Women says that captaincy was not easy for her especially when India were going hard with the bat. She feels that India were a little bit below par with the bat and adds that they knew that if they batted well and start off well, they can capitalize at the backend. Hopes to tighten up in the bowling and fielding department but adds that overall they played very good cricket on the day.

Beth Mooney (89* off 57 balls) is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for her match-winning knock. Mooney says that she loves putting the Australian shirt on and is lucky to have been able to play well against India. Adds that they knew beforehand that the wicket here would be good for batting and they were excited to play on wickets that had good bounce and fast outfields.

The India Women skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur says the score they put on was a decent one. Tells that they were in the game till the 13th over but they were poor in the fielding department and they created chances but could not hold onto them. She then talks about the poor fielding and says that these things happen in cricket and adds that Radha Yadav is their best fielder but if they wanted to restrict a strong team like the Aussies they needed to take their chances. Mentions that the dew definitely played a part and sometimes it becomes difficult to judge the ball.
The presentation ceremony...

Tahlia McGrath says that it is nice to start off the series with a win. Tells that they have not played together as a team for a long time since the Commonwealth Games and they are happy to get going. Adds that they try to push each other in the training and try to work hard as possible and get better which drives them as a team. Mentions that India batted well, especially at the backend but they saw that there was value for shots and they just needed to build a strong partnership and then take it from there. On being asked about her bowling, she says that they are pretty spoiled for choices with bowlers but she is ready to go and she will be ready when Alyssa Healy needs her.

Earlier in the game, Alyssa Healy won the toss and opted to bowl first in what was her first T20I game as full captain of the side. This decision didn't go that well as the Indian openers were able to make good use of the Powerplay. The visitors came roaring back by picking up quick wickets and that slowed down the Indian innings. Harmanpreet Kaur and Devika Vaidya held the innings together after which it was Richa Ghosh and Deepti Sharma who played fiery cameos to propel India Women to 172 runs. Kim Garth on debut bowled well and so did Ellyse Perry but their spinners weren't able to control the game. In reply, Australia Women lost just the solo wicket as Beth Mooney played a wonderful knock to take them over the line without any fuss. Let's now join Tahlia McGrath for a quick chat...

India Women will be disappointed with that effort, both with the ball and especially in the field. They dropped a couple of chances early on which proved to be extremely costly and the ground fielding was way below par. With more than a decent score on the board, the Indian pacers started off reasonably well but once the charge came from the opposition batters, they hardly had any answers. The debutant, Anjali Sarvani proved to be the most economical bowler whereas the likes of Devika Vaidya and Meghna Singh received a lot of stick. They will now look to improve upon this effort and get back on level terms.

Chasing a pretty big target of 173 runs, the Australian innings got off to a bit of a sedate start but soon enough, the experienced pair of Alyssa Healy and Beth Mooney at the top was able to put the bad balls away and put on 73 runs for the first wicket. After the stand broke, there was a quiet spell as Tahlia McGrath took a bit of time to find her feet. Mooney though just went into overdrive as she toyed with the field and kept on finding the fence. The southpaw ended the game unbeaten on 89 runs and it was her knock really that made a difference. Mooney and McGrath put on exactly 100 runs to seal the win with McGrath scoring freely towards the end as well.

A pretty straightforward victory in the end for Australia Women and they extend their unbeaten streak to 16 matches in this format of the game. The visitors take a 1-0 lead in the five-match T20I series and lay down the marker for the rest of the tour.

Here it is! Australia Women win this game comfortably by 9 wickets! Deepti Sharma bowls a quicker and flatter delivery on middle and leg. Tahlia McGrath nudges it to deep backward square leg and comes back for the second run with ease. Once again, Australia Women have shown why there are the best team in the world!

Shortish and outside off. Tahlia McGrath tries to cut it again. However, she gets a thick outside edge that rolls towards left of short third man and a single is taken. Two needed for Australia Women to win this game!
A slower delivery again. This time it fuller and on middle. Beth Mooney shimmies down the track and knocks it to long off for a single.
Short and outside off. Tahlia McGrath cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Short and way outside off. It is a slower delivery and Tahlia McGrath gets away across to her right to pull it but mistimes it to backward square leg.
A fuller delivery angling into leg. Beth Mooney tries to clip it but misses. The ball hits her pads and rolls towards the leg side. A leg bye is taken.
Shortish delivery and outside off. Tahlia McGrath cuts it to point for a single.
Anjali Sarvani is back into the attack.

FOUR! Another boundary and what was expected to be a stiff chase for the Aussies has turned out to be a cakewalk. On the shorter side and around off. Beth Mooney again shows her class and just purposely plays it late and opens her bat face to guide it in the gap towards the third man fence.
FOUR! What a lovely placement this is! Back of a length, around middle. Beth Mooney plays it late and clips it wide of short fine leg for a boundary. 11 needed from 19 balls now.
Short delivery and on off. Tahlia McGrath pulls it firmly to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Another boundary and must say, this game is all but over for India now! Short and wide outside off. Tahlia McGrath skips down the track and slaps it towards the point fence for a boundary.

SIX! Tahlia McGrath wants to finish this off quickly now! Singh lands it on a length, on off. Tahlia McGrath gets across to her right and swings her blade with full might to take the ball all the way over the backward square leg fence for a maximum.
Dot ball! On a good length, on off. Tahlia McGrath defends it back to the bowler.
Meghna Singh (1-0-8-0) is back on.

FOUR! Boundary to end the over and Australia Women just need 26 now from 24 balls! They have made a mockery of this chase! A full toss, outside off. Beth Mooney drives it square off the wicket on the off side and finds the gap again as the ball races away towards the fence.
Slower delivery and outside off. Beth Mooney drives it right of long off and picks up an easy two. Australia Women are doing it very easily now.
Bowls it full and on off. Tahlia McGrath drives it to long off for a single.
Short and outside off. Beth Mooney cuts it off the outside half of her blade to left of short third man. Meghna Singh makes a good stop with a dive and a single is taken.
A very full delivery and outside off. Tahlia McGrath pushes it to sweeper cover for just a single.
A full delivery on off. Tahlia McGrath drives it to deep extra cover for a couple.
Renuka Singh is back to bowl her last over.

FOUR! A fourth boundary in the over and 18 runs come off it. A bit too full from Devika Vaidya, ends up being a full toss outside off. Mooney caresses it through the cover region for a boundary. 37 needed now off 30 balls.

FOUR! Beth Mooney is playing a match-winning knock here and the Indian bowlers seem out of sorts. Flighted delivery around off stump, Mooney skips down the track and lofts it over extra cover to find the fence.

Yet another misfield, this time from the Indian skipper. Floated up well outside off, Tahlia McGrath drives it straight to Harmanpreet Kaur at extra cover but the ball just comes to her quickly and a fumble is caused. They get a single.
Tossed up again but in line with the stumps this time, Mooney eases it down the ground for a single.
FOUR! It's just too easy at the moment for Beth Mooney. Tossed up outside off, Mooney uses her feet yet again and strokes it well wide of long off for a boundary.
FOUR! Up and over! Beth Mooney looks to use her feet but Devika Vaidya cleverly pushes it full and wide. Mooney adjusts well and gets enough elevation to get it over the point region for a boundary.
Devika Vaidya is back on. Can she break this partnership?

FOUR! Another misfield and it will be another boundary here, poor work all-around from India Women. Full and outside off, Tahlia McGrath advances and drives it firmly but straight to cover where the fielder misfields and the ball races away into the fence.
A tad shorter and around leg stump, Mooney comes forward and then goes back to work it past square leg for a single.
MISFIELD AND FOUR! Tossed up around middle and leg, Beth Mooney heaves it towards wide long on where the ball just skids off the turf and Jemimah Rodrigues fumbles. Mooney picks up another boundary.

That's FIFTY then for Beth Mooney and it is her 6th half-century against India in this format and once again she has shown her class. Flighted delivery outside off, Mooney uses her feet and strokes it towards sweeper cover for a couple of runs. Mooney holds the key here for Australia Women.
Brilliant effort from the skipper. Tossed up around the leg stump, Beth Mooney comes down the track and flicks it to the left of mid-wicket where Harmanpreet Kaur makes a diving stop.
Floated up outside off, Tahlia McGrath shuffles and swings it towards square leg. The fielder over there fumbles and they get an easy single in the end.
Will Radha Yadav continue? Yes, she will. Her last over went for only five runs and India need another tight over from her.
Quicker and flatter, skidding across the off stump. Beth Mooney cuts it straight towards point. 14 off the over, a big one for Australia Women.
FOUR! Australia Women getting a move on here. Tosses it up wide of the off pole, Beth Mooney dances down the track and lofts it inside-out over cover for yet another boundary.
This is drifted in full and on off stump, Tahlia McGrath knocks it down to long off for one.
FOUR! Cheeky but effective from Tahlia McGrath. Full and outside off, McGrath plays the reverse paddle and gets it fine enough, past the fielder at short third man for a boundary.

FOUR BYES! Through everyone! Tahlia McGrath pre-meditates and shuffles a long way past the off stump. Deepti just holds it back a touch and flights it well outside off stump. McGrath misses the slog and Richa Ghosh fails to collect the ball as well. The ball trickles into the third man fence.
Deepti Sharma starts off with a floater outside off. Beth Mooney advances and hits it down to wide long off for just a single.
Deepti Sharma is back on for her second over. Her first over went for 8 runs.
Radha Yadav sees Mooney coming this time and tries to fire it in at the toes. Mooney gets the front leg out of the way and hits it towards mid off for a run.
Flighted delivery, around off and Beth Mooney uses her feet to drive it through wide mid off for a couple of runs.
Floated up around off, this is stroked away through covers for a single.

Half an appeal from the keeper for lbw but the impact is well outside off. This is looped up around off and turning away. Tahlia McGrath shuffles across the stumps and looks to slog it leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads.

Excellent fielding from Jemimah Rodrigues. Tossed up around off, Beth Mooney skips down the track and slogs it away well in front of mid-wicket. Rodrigues moves quickly to her right from deep mid-wicket and keeps it down to just a single.
Beth Mooney advances down the track and Radha Yadav just gives it a nice loop. Mooney ends up pushing it back towards the bowler.

Nicely bowled! Anjali Sarvani goes full and wide and finds the blockhole as well. Tahlia McGrath yet again tries to make a bit of room and drive through covers but is well beaten. 86 needed now off 54 balls.
Pulls the length back a touch and keeps it outside off, McGrath fails to get it away on the off side.
Fullish length and angling across the off stump, McGrath backs away and hits it square of the wicket, to the left of the fielder at deep point for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Nicely driven! Overpitched around off, Tahlia McGrath drives it off the front foot and creams it through extra cover for a boundary.
Swing and a miss! Keeps it very full and outside off, Tahlia McGrath moves past the leg stump trying to open up the off side but fails to connect.
Starts the new spell with a full and wide one, Tahlia McGrath mistimes the drives towards mid off.
Anjali Sarvani (2-0-17-0) is back into the attack.
FOUR! Spoils the over with a boundary!  Bangs it short and on middle. Beth Mooney tries to hook it but gets a top edge. The ball goes away towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
A length ball and it is angled across the left-hander. Beth Mooney skips down the track and tries to slap it but misses.

Oh, is this a dropped chance? Yes, it is! Radha Yadav drops the catch again. Shortish delivery and outside off. Tahlia McGrath cuts it uppishly towards right of point. Radha Yadav dives to catch it and gets both hands to it but the ball pops out of her hands. Single taken.
Bangs it short and on off. Beth Mooney pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Bowls a full delivery on off. Tahlia McGrath tries to drive it but the ball goes off the thick outside edge to third man for a single.
Singh starts with a tad shorter delivery on middle. Mooney skips down the track and works it to mid on for a single.
Meghna Singh is now brought into the attack.
Touch shorter and around off. Tahlia McGrath tries to push it towards the off side but misses.
Tahlia McGrath walks in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Devika Vaidya strikes and Alyssa Healy departs against the run of play here! A much-needed breakthrough for India. This is a gentle full toss on off. Healy drives but does so uppishly and ends up hitting it straight to Harmanpreet Kaur at covers. She takes an easy catch and Alyssa Healy is gutted. A good knock from her but India would hope to build on this now.
Commentary.Howout: c Harmanpreet Kaur b Devika Vaidya

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Alyssa Healy is showing her full range here! Tossed up, on off. Healy reverse-sweeps it and gets in the gap through the backward point region for a boundary.
Tossed up, on off. Beth Mooney reaches the pitch of the ball and drives it to long off for a single.
Flatter and touch shorter on off. Beth Mooney punches it to cover-point.
A fuller delivery, around off. Beth Mooney tries to paddle it but misses and gets hit on the pads.

SIX! This is just effortless hitting, these two Australian openers are taking this game away from India! 11 from this over. Tossed up, on off. Healy skips down the track and plays a delightful lofted drive over long off for a maximum.
Angled in on middle. Healy skips down the track and works it to mid-wicket.
Nicely tossed up, on middle. Just short of full length and Alyssa Healy defends it off the front foot.
Flighted delivery on off. Beth Mooney shimmies down the track and heaves it off the bounce to the deep mid-wicket fielder for a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Tossed up, on middle. Beth Mooney sweeps it through the square leg region for a boundary. Australia Women are off to a flier here!
Starts off with a flatter delivery on middle. Beth Mooney works it to short fine leg.
Loopy delivery on off. Beth Mooney knocks it down to long off and retains the strike with a single. 116 still needed from 78 balls!
Nicely bowled, a googly on off. Mooney drives it to the cover fielder.
Tossed up, on off. Healy drives it to long off for a single.
SIX! Over the ropes this time and she has silenced the crowd here! On off and fuller. Healy gets across to her right and sweeps it over deep square leg for a maximum.
Healy skips down the track and Devika Vaidya pulls her length back slightly. Healy slaps it to deep extra-cover region for a couple.
Lovely delivery to start. Tossed up, on off. It turns away and Healy misses the cut shot as she makes room to play that shot.
Touch shorter and around off. Healy punches it to sweeper cover for a single. Australia Women are 47/0 after the Powerplay.
Bowls it wide of the off stump again but it is flatter and quicker. Healy tries to play a reverse-sweep but misses.
Short and wide outside off. Beth Mooney cuts it to deep point for a single.
WIDE! Bowls it way too wide, outside off. Beth Mooney leaves it alone.
FOUR! Beth Mooney is just unstoppable at the moment! This is short and outside off. Mooney gets an under-edge here as she tries to cut it. The ball goes through the gully region for a boundary.
Touch shorter again and outside off. Healy cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Deepti Sharma starts off with a widish delivery, outside off. It is slower through the air and Healy who tries to cut it, misses.
This is pitched up on off stump, Mooney drives it straight to extra cover.

FOUR! Make that a hat-trick of boundaries now! Length ball on leg stump, Beth Mooney shuffles yet again and smartly just tucks it away behind square on the leg side for a boundary. Mooney just toying with the field there.
FOUR! Thumped! Full again around off stump, this time Beth Mooney reaches out and whacks it right back over the bowler's head for another boundary.
FOUR! Slogged away! Full and outside off, angling away. Beth Mooney shuffles past the off stump and drags it through the vacant mid-wicket region to pick up a boundary.
Length ball outside off, Healy hits it wide of mid off and picks up a single towards deep extra cover.
This is pitched up around off stump, Alyssa Healy plays it on the up and towards mid off.
Full again and angling in from around off. Beth Mooney drills it straight to the fielder at mid on.
On a fuller length and slanted across the off stump, this is played away towards backward point.
Smart batting just keeping it moving after the boundary. Good length around leg stump, Healy tucks it through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Slapped away! A half-volley now well outside off, Alyssa Healy pounces on it and creams it through cover-point for a second boundary in the over.
This is fuller and around off, Mooney drives it square of the wicket towards sweeper cover and collects a single.
FOUR! Putting the debutant under pressure right away. Back of a length and around off, Beth Mooney pulls it off the back foot and through wide mid on for a boundary.
Short of a length and on the fifth stump line, Monney taps this one in front of covers and picks up a single. A rather watchful start this from the Aussie openers.
Yet another dot! Fullish length outside off, Mooney drives but cannot pierce the inner ring.
BEATEN! This is lovely bowling from Renuka Singh. On a nagging length and just angling it across the left-hander. Beth Mooney looks to cut it late but is beaten past the outside edge.
Around the top of off, Beth Mooney just blocks it out.

DROPPED! In and out! Good length again and keeps it wide of the off stump. Beth Mooney reaches out and just cuts it uppishly towards backward point. Radha Yadav dives to her left but the ball gets big on her and the chance is spilled.
WIDE! On a good length and well outside the off stump. This is left alone for a wide.

There is a huge appeal from Richa Ghosh behind the stumps but the umpire remains unmoved. Renuka Singh just slides this one on a length and well outside the off stump. Beth Mooney tries to reach it but the ball sneaks under the willow. Ghosh appeals for a caught-behind but no one else is interested.
Good length, angling in from off stump, Beth Mooney works it away through mid-wicket and picks up a run.
Shorter again and around leg stump, this is whipped away towards deep square leg but only for a single.
Much better this time around. Pitches it a bit further up and on off stump, the ball nips back in a touch as well. Healy blocks it out.
FOUR! Anjali Sarvani errs in line and Alyssa Healy duly punishes her. This is a tad shorter and on the pads, Healy pulls it away past short fine leg and into the fence for a boundary.
Fraction shorter and around off, Mooney pulls it down to long on and rotates the strike.
Anjali Sarvani starts off her debut spell with a length ball, angling into off stump. Beth Mooney watchfully pushes it out towards mid on.
The debutant, Anjali Sarvani to share the new ball with Renuka Singh.

EDGED AND FOUR! Renuka Singh goes a bit wider of the crease and angles in a fullish delivery around off stump. Alyssa Healy looks to drive on the up but gets an outside edge that goes fine of the diving fielder at first slip and into the fence.
Short of a length and outside off, this is tapped away off the back foot and in front of point for an easy single.
Back of a length and outside off, Beth Mooney looks to punch it away but mistimes it on the off side. Mooney looks to steal a single but is sent back by her partner.
A touch fuller and around off, Alyssa Healy backs away a bit and just pushes it into the gap around cover-point to get off the mark with a single.
Good length again, around the top of off, Alyssa Healy stays watchful and blocks it back onto the deck.

Renuka Singh starts off with a good-length delivery angling it across the left-hander. Beth Mooney stays on the back foot and just guides it down to third man for a single. Mooney and Australia Women are underway!
